Where we come from

See it, hear it,
wear it.

Our story

Every hat carries
a little piece
of home.

More than a hat… it's our roots.

Sample copy: ASLANA began with one idea, that the Saidi patterns on our grandparents' shawls and woven bands belong on the street too. Everything is drawn from Upper Egypt: the palms, the felucca sails, the village skyline.

Questions

Good to know.

How do I use the code ASLNA 1?

Add your hats to the bag and mention the code at checkout. The 25% limited-time offer is already shown on every hat.

Which size should I pick?

Our hats come in S/M and L/XL. They run slightly large, so if you are between sizes, go one down. (Sample copy)

How do I place an order?

Add your favourites to the bag, enter your details at checkout, and we will contact you to confirm delivery.

How long does delivery take, and can I return a hat?

Delivery takes 2 to 4 working days in Cairo and Giza, and 3 to 6 working days to the rest of Egypt, Upper Egypt included. You can exchange or return a hat within 7 days of receiving it, as long as it is unworn and still has its label.
